description: Fetch the structured result of a completed inference by id, returned as a compact map of extracted fields (plus raw_text if it was requested). V2 API: GET /v2/inferences/{inference_id}.

inference_id.description: Inference id (from a Processed job's result_url, or from mindee_extract_document).

raw.description: Return the full unshaped API response instead of the compact fields map. Default false.

name: mindee_get_inference
title: Get extraction result
